blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: VPPF（Vacuum Pressure Powder Filler，真空壓力粉末充填機）的速度優勢來自劑量盤（dosing disc）的旋轉設計：每轉一圈就完成一輪充填循環。配備多條充填道（dosing lanes）與多個充填頭（fill heads），整體產能可顯著提升，某些配置可達每分鐘數百個容器。
blocks.en: The speed advantage of the VPPF (Vacuum Pressure Powder Filler) comes from the rotating design of the dosing disc: each revolution completes one fill cycle. With multiple dosing lanes and multiple fill heads, overall output can rise significantly, and some configurations reach several hundred containers per minute.

blocks.zh: 無菌干預（aseptic intervention）：指在無菌環境中需要人員介入的操作。充填頭數量越多，設置時需要的無菌組裝步驟越多，每一個步驟都是潛在的微生物污染機會。
blocks.en: Aseptic intervention: an operation in the aseptic environment that requires personnel involvement. The more fill heads there are, the more aseptic assembly steps the setup requires, and every step is a potential opportunity for microbial contamination.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像一台有多個出水口的咖啡機：出水口越多，同時可以沖泡的咖啡越多，但每次啟動前需要確認每個出水口都清潔且正確安裝。若一個出水口沒裝好，整批咖啡都可能受到污染。VPPF 的多充填頭邏輯完全相同——速度換來的是更多的設置複雜度與無菌保證挑戰。
blocks.en: Picture a coffee machine with several outlets: the more outlets, the more cups can be brewed at once, but before each start you must confirm that every outlet is clean and correctly installed. If one outlet is not fitted properly, the whole batch of coffee can be contaminated. The multi-fill-head logic of the VPPF is exactly the same: speed is paid for with more setup complexity and greater sterility assurance challenges.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 決策層級提醒：無菌保證（Sterility Assurance）永遠是第一優先。評估「增加充填頭提升產能」時，必須先問：增加的無菌干預是否已在 APS（Aseptic Process Simulation，無菌製程模擬）中被充分驗證？若不能確認，產能提升的商業效益必須讓步於無菌保證的要求。
blocks.en: Decision hierarchy reminder: sterility assurance always comes first. When evaluating "adding fill heads to raise output", first ask whether the added aseptic interventions have been adequately validated in the APS (Aseptic Process Simulation). If this cannot be confirmed, the commercial benefit of higher output must yield to the requirement for sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若 VPPF 配備兩條充填道，APS 的設計應如何調整，確保所有充填頭的無菌干預都被涵蓋？
blocks.en: If a VPPF has two dosing lanes, how should the APS design be adjusted to ensure that the aseptic interventions of all fill heads are covered?

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，客戶要求最大化產能，但現有設備只有單充填頭。你會如何建議客戶在產能與無菌風險之間取得平衡？
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, a client asks for maximum output, but the existing equipment has only a single fill head. How would you advise the client to balance output against sterility risk?

blocks.zh: 16.2.7 Vacuum Pressure Powder Filler Costs: Initial and Ongoing 16.2.7 真空壓力粉末充填機成本：初始與持續
blocks.en: 16.2.7 Vacuum Pressure Powder Filler Costs: Initial and Ongoing

blocks.zh: 格式件（format parts）與劑量盤（dosing discs）：VPPF 以劑量盤決定充填劑量——不同劑量需要不同孔徑的劑量盤。若一台設備需要支援多個充填規格（如 50 mg、200 mg、500 mg），就需要購置對應的劑量盤套件，這是初始投資的重要成本項目。
blocks.en: Format parts and dosing discs: the VPPF determines the fill dose with the dosing disc, and different doses require discs with different bore sizes. If one machine must support several fill sizes (for example 50 mg, 200 mg and 500 mg), a matching set of dosing discs must be purchased, which is a significant item in the initial investment.

blocks.zh: 消耗品（consumables）：過濾器（filters）、O 型環（O-rings）、活塞（pistons）是 VPPF 的主要耗材，需定期更換。壓縮空氣與真空系統（若使用本地產生方式）也有乾燥劑（desiccant）等耗材成本。
blocks.en: Consumables: filters, O-rings and pistons are the main consumables of the VPPF and must be replaced periodically. Compressed air and vacuum systems (if generated locally) also carry consumable costs such as desiccant.

blocks.zh: 氣動旋轉接頭（pneumatic rotary joint）：這是劑量盤背面的旋轉接口，長時間旋轉摩擦後需要更換。使用壽命通常在數百萬次循環以上，屬於長週期計劃性維護項目。
blocks.en: Pneumatic rotary joint: this is the rotating interface on the back of the dosing disc, and it needs replacement after long-term rotational friction. Service life is typically several million cycles or more, so it is a long-interval, planned maintenance item.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula — TCO 框架
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation: TCO Framework

blocks.zh:
VPPF 總擁有成本（TCO）組成：

初始成本：
  設備本體
+ 劑量盤套件（每種充填規格一套）
+ 壓縮空氣 / 真空系統（若本地化設置）
+ 隔離器或 RABS 整合工程費用

年度持續成本：
  過濾器更換費用
+ O 型環 / 活塞耗材
+ 壓縮空氣系統乾燥劑
+ 軸承、軸套、皮帶更換

低頻大件更換（按週期計）：
+ 氣動旋轉接頭（數百萬次循環後）
+ 驗證 / 再確效費用（格式更換後）
blocks.en:
Components of VPPF total cost of ownership (TCO):

Initial costs:
  Equipment itself
+ Dosing disc sets (one set per fill size)
+ Compressed air / vacuum system (if installed locally)
+ Isolator or RABS integration engineering costs

Annual ongoing costs:
  Filter replacement costs
+ O-ring / piston consumables
+ Compressed air system desiccant
+ Bearing, bushing and belt replacement

Low-frequency major replacements (by interval):
+ Pneumatic rotary joint (after several million cycles)
+ Validation / revalidation costs (after format changes)

blocks.zh: 這就像買一台高階印表機：設備本身的價格只是起點。每種紙張規格需要不同的進紙模組（劑量盤套件），墨匣（O 型環）定期更換，印表頭（氣動旋轉接頭）在數百萬次列印後也需更換。評估時必須把整個生命週期的耗材成本都算進去，而不只是看設備標牌價。
blocks.en: It is like buying a high-end printer: the price of the machine is only the starting point. Each paper size needs a different feed module (the dosing disc set), the ink cartridges (O-rings) are replaced regularly, and the print head (the pneumatic rotary joint) also needs replacing after millions of prints. The evaluation must include the consumable costs over the whole life cycle, not just the sticker price of the equipment.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 業務中，客戶常問：「這台設備能填我們三種規格（50 mg、250 mg、800 mg）嗎？」正確回答不只是技術上的「能」，而是要告知客戶：每種規格需要對應的劑量盤，設備切換（changeover）需要拆裝、清洗、重新校正充填重量，這些成本與時間都應反映在報價與交期計畫中。
blocks.en: In CDMO business, clients often ask, "Can this machine fill our three strengths (50 mg, 250 mg and 800 mg)?" The correct answer is not just a technical "yes". You must tell the client that each strength needs its own dosing disc, and that a changeover requires dismantling, cleaning and re-calibrating the fill weight. These costs and times should be reflected in the quotation and the delivery plan.

blocks.zh: 若 VPPF 每年需更換 12 組 O 型環（每組 $500），以及每 5 年更換一次氣動旋轉接頭（$15,000），請計算 10 年的耗材總成本。
blocks.en: If a VPPF needs 12 sets of O-rings replaced each year ($500 per set) and the pneumatic rotary joint replaced every 5 years ($15,000), calculate the total consumable cost over 10 years.

blocks.zh: 客戶決定安裝本地化壓縮空氣產生系統而非使用公用系統，這對 TCO 有何影響？有哪些隱性成本需要考量？
blocks.en: A client decides to install a local compressed air generation system rather than use the site utility. What is the effect on TCO? What hidden costs need to be considered?

blocks.zh: 16.2.8 Vacuum Pressure Powder Filler System Complexity: Setup, Handling, and Changeover 16.2.8 真空壓力粉末充填機系統複雜度：安裝、操作與換線
blocks.en: 16.2.8 Vacuum Pressure Powder Filler System Complexity: Setup, Handling, and Changeover

blocks.zh: 超級板設計（super plate design）：這是 VPPF 設置複雜度管理的重要創新。傳統方式是將零件滅菌後，在無菌區（Grade A）逐一組裝，操作時間長且干預風險高。Super plate 的概念是：先在 Grade C 環境完整組裝整個充填模組，再整體放入滅菌釜（autoclave）滅菌，最後以整體方式運送並掛載到充填線。在無菌區只需完成一個連接動作，大幅減少干預的複雜度與污染風險。
blocks.en: Super plate design: this is an important innovation for managing VPPF setup complexity. The traditional approach sterilizes the parts and then assembles them one by one in the aseptic area (Grade A), which takes a long time and carries a high intervention risk. The super plate concept is to assemble the entire fill module completely in a Grade C environment, sterilize it as a whole in an autoclave, and then transport it as a unit and mount it on the filling line. Only one connection step remains in the aseptic area, which greatly reduces intervention complexity and contamination risk.

blocks.zh: 劑量盤堵塞（plugged chamber）：劑量盤上的孔道是粉末通道。若粉末顆粒過大、吸濕或靜電聚集，可能造成堵塞，導致某腔室無法正常充填。搭配 100% 重量檢測可自動剔除受影響的容器，而不需要停線更換劑量盤。
blocks.en: Plugged chamber: the bores in the dosing disc are the powder channels. If powder particles are too large, hygroscopic or electrostatically aggregated, a chamber may become plugged and fail to fill properly. Combined with 100% weight checking, the affected containers can be rejected automatically without stopping the line to change the dosing disc.

blocks.zh: 自動活塞調整：現代 VPPF 結合 100% 重量感測器，可即時自動調整活塞行程（piston stroke）以補償充填重量漂移，這是 CPP（Critical Process Parameter，關鍵製程參數）的閉迴路控制。
blocks.en: Automatic piston adjustment: a modern VPPF combines 100% weight sensors so that the piston stroke can be adjusted automatically in real time to compensate for fill weight drift. This is closed-loop control of a CPP (Critical Process Parameter).

blocks.zh: 傳統無菌組裝就像「先消毒每一塊積木，再在手術室裡一塊一塊拼起來」——每個動作都是風險。Super plate 則是「先在普通房間把積木全部拼好，再整體放入高壓消毒鍋，拼好的成品再推進手術室直接插上使用」——只有最後一個連接步驟在高風險環境中完成。設計哲學是：最小化在無菌環境中的操作步驟。
blocks.en: Traditional aseptic assembly is like "sterilizing every building block first, then putting them together one by one in an operating room", and every action is a risk. The super plate is like "assembling all the blocks in an ordinary room, putting the finished assembly into the autoclave, and then wheeling the finished product into the operating room and simply plugging it in", so only the last connection step is performed in the high-risk environment. The design philosophy is to minimize the number of operations carried out in the aseptic environment.

blocks.zh: 劑量盤運行中更換是重大干預（significant intervention）：文件明確不建議在充填中途更換劑量盤。原因：需要備用的已滅菌劑量盤在場、需要清空充填線、需要完整 EM 取樣，以及重新校正充填重量。如此繁複的步驟不僅耗時，更帶來極高的無菌保證風險。正確的預防策略是在可行性評估（feasibility study）階段就充分測試粉末特性，選擇合適的設備設計。
blocks.en: Changing a dosing disc during a run is a significant intervention: the document clearly advises against changing the dosing disc in the middle of filling. The reasons: a spare sterilized dosing disc must be on hand, the filling line must be cleared, full EM sampling is needed, and the fill weight must be recalibrated. Such a laborious sequence is not only time-consuming but also carries a very high sterility assurance risk. The correct preventive strategy is to test the powder characteristics thoroughly at the feasibility study stage and choose a suitable equipment design.

blocks.zh: Super plate 的 Grade A 要求：若採用 super plate 設計，從滅菌釜卸載面到充填線的整條運輸路徑，必須維持在 Grade A 潔淨度下——這對廠房動線與空間規劃有直接影響，是廠房設計階段必須提前考慮的因素。
blocks.en: Grade A requirement for the super plate: if a super plate design is used, the entire transport path from the unloading face of the autoclave to the filling line must be maintained at Grade A cleanliness. This directly affects facility flow and space planning and must be considered early in facility design.

blocks.zh: 評估採購 VPPF 時，應向設備商確認：是否支援 super plate 設計？若支援，充填線需預留什麼連接介面？滅菌釜到充填線的運輸路徑需符合什麼潔淨度要求？這些問題的答案直接影響廠房設計方案與 GMP 合規成本，應在廠房規劃早期（conceptual design 階段）就納入考量。
blocks.en: When evaluating the purchase of a VPPF, confirm with the equipment supplier: is the super plate design supported? If so, what connection interface must the filling line provide? What cleanliness requirements apply to the transport path from the autoclave to the filling line? The answers directly affect the facility design and the GMP compliance cost, and should be included early in facility planning (conceptual design stage).

blocks.zh: 比較「傳統無菌組裝」與「super plate 概念」，各自的主要無菌保證風險點在哪裡？
blocks.en: Compare "traditional aseptic assembly" with the "super plate concept". Where are the main sterility assurance risk points of each?

blocks.zh: 若充填過程中偵測到某個充填腔室出現劑量不足，搭配 100% 重量檢測設備，操作員的處置流程應該是什麼？
blocks.en: If underfilling is detected in one fill chamber during filling, and 100% weight checking equipment is in place, what should the operator's response procedure be?

blocks.zh: 「縮短每批次充填時長以減少劑量盤堵塞機率」這個緩解措施，對生產效率與商業效益有何影響？如何在風險評估中呈現這個 trade-off？
blocks.en: What effect does the mitigation "shorten the fill duration of each batch to reduce the chance of dosing disc plugging" have on production efficiency and commercial benefit? How would you present this trade-off in the risk assessment?

blocks.zh: 16.2.9 Vacuum Pressure Pump Filler Maintenance and Aging through the Product Lifecycle 16.2.9 真空壓力泵充填機在產品生命週期中之維護保養與老化
blocks.en: 16.2.9 Vacuum Pressure Pump Filler Maintenance and Aging through the Product Lifecycle

blocks.zh: 自潤滑設計（self-lubrication）：接觸產品的機械零件不能使用外部潤滑劑（如油脂），因為潤滑劑可能污染無菌粉末產品。VPPF 的產品接觸件必須使用自潤滑材料（如 PTFE、特殊工程塑膠）或乾式軸承。
blocks.en: Self-lubrication: mechanical parts in contact with the product cannot use external lubricants (such as grease), because lubricant could contaminate the sterile powder product. Product-contact parts of the VPPF must use self-lubricating materials (such as PTFE or special engineering plastics) or dry bearings.

blocks.zh: 防塵套（dust boots）：覆蓋在機械凸輪或軸桿上的彈性防護套，防止粉末微粒侵入機械部件，同時防止潤滑劑從機械部件洩漏到充填環境。若 dust boot 破損，粉末可能進入機械件導致磨損加速，或機油洩漏污染產品環境。
blocks.en: Dust boots: flexible protective sleeves over mechanical cams or shafts that keep powder particles out of the mechanism and also stop lubricant leaking from the mechanism into the filling environment. If a dust boot is damaged, powder can enter the mechanism and accelerate wear, or machine oil can leak and contaminate the product environment.

blocks.zh: VPPF 的維護就像汽車定期保養：你不會等到引擎壞掉才換機油，而是按里程數提前更換。VPPF 以「充填循環次數」為里程表，每達到設備商建議的循環次數，就執行對應的 PM（Preventive Maintenance，預防性維護）項目。越依照計劃執行 PM，越能避免設備在批次充填中途故障，導致整批產品報廢。
blocks.en: Maintaining a VPPF is like servicing a car regularly: you do not wait for the engine to fail before changing the oil, you change it ahead of time by mileage. The VPPF uses "fill cycle count" as its odometer, and each time the cycle count recommended by the equipment supplier is reached, the corresponding PM (Preventive Maintenance) items are carried out. The more faithfully the PM is executed as planned, the better you avoid a breakdown in the middle of a batch that would scrap the whole batch.

blocks.zh: VPPF 的維護哲學是計劃性預防維護，而非被動式故障維修。重要提醒：每次 PM 後，若更換了接觸粉末的零件，可能需要重新確認充填性能（re-qualification of fill weights）。這是影響生產計劃的關鍵因素——在 CDMO 的生產排程中，必須提前預留 PM 視窗與可能的再確效時間，才能避免對客戶交期造成衝擊。
blocks.en: The maintenance philosophy for the VPPF is planned preventive maintenance rather than reactive repair. Important reminder: after each PM, if a powder-contact part has been replaced, re-qualification of fill weights may be needed. This is a key factor affecting production planning: in CDMO production scheduling, PM windows and possible re-qualification time must be reserved in advance to avoid affecting client delivery dates.

blocks.zh: 若 VPPF 的 dust boot 在充填進行中發生破損，操作員應如何處置？此事件應如何記錄（偏差報告？還是日常記錄？）？
blocks.en: If a dust boot on the VPPF is damaged during filling, how should the operator respond? How should this event be recorded (deviation report, or routine log)?

blocks.zh: 設計 VPPF PM 計劃時，哪些資訊是必要的？（提示：考量零件設計壽命、設備充填速度、年產批次數）
blocks.en: What information is needed to design a VPPF PM plan? (Hint: consider part design life, equipment fill speed and number of batches per year.)

blocks.zh: 16.2.10 Vacuum Pressure Pump Filler Strategy: Single-Use Versus Reusable 16.2.10 真空壓力泵充填機策略：拋棄式與重複使用
blocks.en: 16.2.10 Vacuum Pressure Pump Filler Strategy: Single-Use Versus Reusable

blocks.zh: SUS（Single-Use System，一次性使用系統）：指每次使用後即丟棄的設備組件，無需清洗與滅菌驗證。在液體充填領域，SU 管路、泵頭等已相當普及。然而 VPPF 的劑量盤需要極高精度加工，製造成本高昂，無法以一次性材料經濟地實現。
blocks.en: SUS (Single-Use System): equipment components that are discarded after each use, with no need for cleaning and sterilization validation. In liquid filling, SU tubing and pump heads are already well established. However, the VPPF dosing disc requires extremely precise machining and is costly to make, so it cannot be realized economically in single-use materials.

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證（cleaning validation）：VPPF 由於沒有 SUS 選項，所有接觸產品的部件（劑量盤、料斗、進料管道）在每批次使用後必須進行清洗，且需要通過清潔驗證，證明清洗程序能有效去除前一批次的殘留物，達到規定的殘留限量。
blocks.en: Cleaning validation: because the VPPF has no SUS option, all product-contact parts (dosing disc, hopper, feed lines) must be cleaned after each batch, and the cleaning must pass cleaning validation showing that the cleaning procedure effectively removes residues from the previous batch to the specified residue limit.

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證的合規要求是 VPPF 的重要限制。在 CDMO 多客戶共用設備的場景中，每引入一個新產品，或每更改清洗流程，都可能需要重新執行清潔驗證——這是顯著的時間與法規合規投入。對比 AF 系統，AF 可實現 CIP/SIP，清潔驗證的負擔相對較低（雖然仍然需要）。這是在設備選型時必須納入評估的合規成本因素。
blocks.en: The compliance requirement for cleaning validation is an important limitation of the VPPF. In a CDMO where several clients share equipment, every new product introduced, or every change to the cleaning process, may require cleaning validation to be repeated, which is a significant investment of time and regulatory compliance effort. By comparison, the AF can achieve CIP/SIP, so the cleaning validation burden is relatively lower (although still required). This is a compliance cost factor that must be included in equipment selection.

blocks.zh: SUS 就像外食使用的免洗餐具——用完丟掉，不需要洗碗。VPPF 的劑量盤則像精密的手術器械——每次使用後必須嚴格清洗消毒，且需要有書面紀錄證明清洗有效。越精密的器械，清洗程序越複雜，驗證要求也越高。
blocks.en: SUS is like disposable tableware for takeaway food: use it and throw it away, with no dishes to wash. The VPPF dosing disc is more like a precision surgical instrument: after every use it must be cleaned and disinfected rigorously, with written records proving the cleaning was effective. The more precise the instrument, the more complex the cleaning procedure and the higher the validation requirement.

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 的 VPPF 需要同時支援兩個不同客戶的藥品充填，清潔驗證的設計應考量哪些因素（提示：交叉污染、殘留限量 MACO 計算）？
blocks.en: If a CDMO's VPPF must fill the drug products of two different clients, what factors should the cleaning validation design consider? (Hint: cross-contamination, residue limits and MACO calculation.)

blocks.zh: 從 TCO 的角度，清潔驗證的一次性投入與持續維護成本，應如何在多年服務合約中分攤？
blocks.en: From a TCO perspective, how should the one-time investment and ongoing maintenance cost of cleaning validation be apportioned over a multi-year service contract?

blocks.zh: 16.2.11 Vacuum Pressure Pump Filler Clean-In-Place/Sterilize-In-Place 16.2.11 真空壓力泵充填機就地清洗（CIP）／就地滅菌（SIP）
blocks.en: 16.2.11 Vacuum Pressure Pump Filler Clean-In-Place/Sterilize-In-Place

blocks.zh: CIP（Clean-In-Place，就地清洗）/ SIP（Sterilize-In-Place，就地滅菌）：無需拆解設備即可完成清洗與滅菌的系統。CIP/SIP 的優點是減少人員干預（降低污染風險）、縮短準備時間、提高效率。
blocks.en: CIP (Clean-In-Place) / SIP (Sterilize-In-Place): systems that allow cleaning and sterilization without dismantling the equipment. The advantages of CIP/SIP are fewer personnel interventions (lower contamination risk), shorter preparation time and higher efficiency.

blocks.zh: VPPF 的 CIP/SIP 限制：只有進料料斗（bulk-feed hopper）等上游組件可以設計為 CIP/SIP 相容。劑量盤、活塞等精密充填件因結構複雜，必須拆下後以人工清洗（或零件清洗機、超音波清洗槽）清潔，再滅菌後重新組裝。
blocks.en: CIP/SIP limitations of the VPPF: only upstream components such as the bulk-feed hopper can be designed to be CIP/SIP compatible. Precision fill parts such as the dosing disc and pistons have complex structures and must be removed and cleaned manually (or in a parts washer or ultrasonic bath), then sterilized and reassembled.

blocks.zh: 超音波清洗（ultrasonic bath）：利用高頻超音波在液體中產生的微氣泡爆破（cavitation），有效清除精密零件表面的殘留粉末，常用於過濾器的清洗。
blocks.en: Ultrasonic bath: uses the collapse of micro-bubbles (cavitation) generated by high-frequency ultrasound in a liquid to effectively remove residual powder from the surfaces of precision parts. It is often used to clean filters.

blocks.zh: 想像廚房的自動洗碗機：鍋子和大碗可以直接放進洗碗機（類比 CIP），但精密的刀具和特殊餐具必須手洗（類比劑量盤的人工清洗）。VPPF 的 CIP/SIP 只覆蓋「大碗」部分，最需要精密清洗的「刀具」反而需要最複雜的人工處理，這是這個技術的先天限制。
blocks.en: Think of an automatic dishwasher in the kitchen: pots and large bowls can go straight into the dishwasher (analogous to CIP), but precision knives and special tableware must be washed by hand (analogous to manual cleaning of the dosing disc). The CIP/SIP of the VPPF covers only the "large bowls", while the "knives" that need the most precise cleaning actually need the most complex manual handling. This is an inherent limitation of the technology.

blocks.zh: CIP/SIP 系統的建置本身也是成本：需要蒸汽疏水閥（steam traps）、排水管、熱電偶（thermocouples）、額外閥門，以及完整的驗證（包含溫度分佈研究與清洗效果驗證）。因此，「局部 CIP/SIP」並非免費的優化——它帶來的工程複雜度與驗證負擔，必須與它節省的清洗時間相互權衡，才能判斷是否值得投資。
blocks.en: Building a CIP/SIP system is itself a cost: it needs steam traps, drain lines, thermocouples, additional valves and full validation (including temperature distribution studies and cleaning effectiveness validation). "Partial CIP/SIP" is therefore not a free optimization: the engineering complexity and validation burden it brings must be weighed against the cleaning time it saves to judge whether the investment is worthwhile.

blocks.zh: 若 VPPF 的進料料斗設計為 CIP/SIP，而劑量盤必須人工清洗，在換產（changeover）計劃中如何統籌安排這兩個並行的清洗路徑？
blocks.en: If the VPPF bulk-feed hopper is designed for CIP/SIP while the dosing disc must be cleaned manually, how should these two parallel cleaning paths be coordinated in the changeover plan?

blocks.zh: 對比 AF（螺旋充填機）的完整 CIP/SIP 能力，VPPF 部分 CIP/SIP 設計在高毒性產品應用上的合規風險是什麼？
blocks.en: Compared with the full CIP/SIP capability of the AF (auger filler), what are the compliance risks of the VPPF's partial CIP/SIP design for highly potent product applications?

blocks.zh: 16.2.12 Use of Vacuum Pressure Powder Filler with Potent or Toxic Products 16.2.12 真空壓力粉末充填機用於高活性或毒性產品
blocks.en: 16.2.12 Use of Vacuum Pressure Powder Filler with Potent or Toxic Products

blocks.zh: 高效能藥物（highly potent compounds）：指具有極低 OEL（Occupational Exposure Limit，職業暴露限值）的活性成分，通常 OEL < 10 μg/m³ 或更低（如細胞毒性藥物）。充填這類產品時，一旦粉末揚散到環境中，會對操作人員構成嚴重健康風險。
blocks.en: Highly potent compounds: active ingredients with a very low OEL (Occupational Exposure Limit), typically an OEL < 10 μg/m³ or lower (such as cytotoxic drugs). When filling such products, once powder becomes airborne in the environment it poses a serious health risk to operators.

blocks.zh: 氣壓充填與揚塵風險：VPPF 以壓縮空氣將粉末從劑量盤推入容器——這個氣流有可能將粉末微粒揚散到充填區域。特別是對於流動性高（motile）或體積密度低（low bulk density）的細粉，揚塵問題更為顯著。
blocks.en: Pneumatic filling and dusting risk: the VPPF uses compressed air to push powder from the dosing disc into the container, and this air flow can disperse powder particles into the filling area. The dusting problem is particularly pronounced for fine powders with high mobility (motile) or low bulk density.

blocks.zh: 就地沖洗（rinsing in place）：在開啟隔離器（isolator）或 RABS 前，先用溶劑或水對設備表面進行沖洗，降低拆解時的暴露風險，之後再將零件袋封取出進行完整清洗。
blocks.en: Rinsing in place: before opening the isolator or RABS, the equipment surfaces are rinsed with solvent or water to reduce exposure risk during dismantling, and the parts are then bagged and removed for full cleaning.

blocks.zh:
決策層級在此清晰呈現：
1. 無菌保證（Sterility Assurance）：VPPF 的離線清洗需求帶來干預風險
2. 產品 CQA（Critical Quality Attribute）：揚塵可能導致充填量不準確
3. 商業需求：客戶可能指定 VPPF 技術

當產品為高毒性粉末時，VPPF 的氣壓充填機制引入了操作員暴露風險，這是一個「設備設計影響員工安全」的典型案例。應在風險評估中明確評估並記錄 VPPF 是否為適合的充填技術，或是否應優先考慮 AF。
blocks.en:
The decision hierarchy is clearly visible here:
1. Sterility assurance: the VPPF's off-line cleaning requirement brings intervention risk
2. Product CQA (Critical Quality Attribute): dusting may cause inaccurate fill amounts
3. Commercial demand: the client may specify VPPF technology

When the product is a highly toxic powder, the pneumatic filling mechanism of the VPPF introduces operator exposure risk, a classic case of "equipment design affecting employee safety". The risk assessment should explicitly evaluate and document whether the VPPF is a suitable filling technology, or whether the AF should be given priority.

blocks.zh: 想像用吹風機把粉末吹入瓶子——粉末越細、越輕，就越容易被氣流帶到瓶子外面。VPPF 的氣壓充填就像這個場景的精密版。若充填的是像麵粉一樣的細粉，就有揚塵問題；若充填的是像沙糖一樣的顆粒，則揚塵少得多，所需氣壓也更小。這個物理特性直接影響高毒性粉末充填時的風險等級。
blocks.en: Imagine using a hair dryer to blow powder into a bottle: the finer and lighter the powder, the more easily the air stream carries it outside the bottle. The pneumatic filling of the VPPF is a precision version of this scenario. With a fine powder like flour there is a dusting problem, whereas with granules like sugar there is much less dusting and the air pressure needed is also lower. This physical property directly determines the risk level when filling highly toxic powders.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 評估是否接受一個新的高毒性粉末充填項目時，技術評估應包含：(1) 產品 OEL 等級；(2) 粉末物理特性（粒徑、流動性、體積密度）；(3) 現有 VPPF 設備是否有充填針頭插入設計與粉塵收集裝置；(4) 是否需要負壓隔離器（negative pressure isolator）作為額外保護層。這些評估結果應記錄在 CMC 技術可行性報告中，作為接案決策的依據。
blocks.en: When a CDMO evaluates whether to accept a new highly toxic powder filling project, the technical assessment should cover: (1) the OEL band of the product; (2) the physical properties of the powder (particle size, flowability, bulk density); (3) whether the existing VPPF equipment has a fill needle insertion design and a dust collection device; and (4) whether a negative pressure isolator is needed as an additional protective layer. The results should be recorded in the CMC technical feasibility report as the basis for the decision to accept the project.

blocks.zh: 若充填產品的 OEL 為 1 μg/m³（高活性），你會建議使用 VPPF 還是 AF？說明你的理由及需要哪些額外的工程控制措施。
blocks.en: If the OEL of the product to be filled is 1 μg/m³ (highly potent), would you recommend the VPPF or the AF? Explain your reasons and which additional engineering controls are needed.

blocks.zh: 「充填針頭插入容器開口的設計」如何減少揚塵風險？這個設計對充填速度（pieces per minute）有何影響？
blocks.en: How does the design of "inserting the fill needle into the container opening" reduce the risk of dusting? What effect does this design have on filling speed (pieces per minute)?

blocks.zh: 為何顆粒狀（granular）產品在 VPPF 充填時揚塵風險比細粉低？這與粉末物理特性中的哪些 CQA 相關？
blocks.en: Why is the dusting risk of granular products lower than that of fine powders when filled on a VPPF? Which CQAs among the powder's physical properties does this relate to?

blocks.zh: 16.2.13 Vacuum Pressure Powder Filler Benefits and Risks 16.2.13 真空壓力粉末充填機效益與風險
blocks.en: 16.2.13 Vacuum Pressure Powder Filler Benefits and Risks

blocks.zh: 充填重量範圍（~2.0 mg to 1000 mg）：VPPF 的劑量盤設計可以覆蓋從極小劑量（2 mg，適合高效能藥物）到中等劑量（1000 mg）的廣泛範圍，這是相對於其他充填技術的重要優勢。
blocks.en: Fill weight range (~2.0 mg to 1000 mg): the VPPF dosing disc design can cover a wide range from very small doses (2 mg, suitable for highly potent drugs) to medium doses (1000 mg), which is an important advantage over other filling technologies.

blocks.zh: 充填精度（~2% to 5% RSD）：精度受充填重量與粉末特性影響——劑量越小、粉末流動性越差，精度越難控制。2% 是理想狀況（流動性好、顆粒均一），5% 是較困難的粉末特性下的典型值。這個精度範圍需與產品的 CQA 充填重量規格相對照，才能判斷是否符合要求。
blocks.en: Fill accuracy (~2% to 5% RSD): accuracy is affected by fill weight and powder properties. The smaller the dose and the poorer the powder flowability, the harder accuracy is to control. 2% is the ideal case (good flowability, uniform particles) and 5% is typical for more difficult powder characteristics. This accuracy range must be compared with the product's CQA fill weight specification to judge whether it meets the requirement.

blocks.zh: 殘餘粉末損失：充填結束後，料斗中可能殘留無法充填的粉末。對於昂貴的原料藥（API），殘餘損失直接影響批次良率（% yield），是重要的商業考量。
blocks.en: Residual powder loss: after filling ends, powder that cannot be filled may remain in the hopper. For expensive active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), residual loss directly affects batch yield (% yield) and is an important commercial consideration.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula — 充填精度評估
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation: Fill Accuracy Evaluation

blocks.zh:
充填精度指標：

RSD (Relative Standard Deviation) =
  (標準差 / 平均充填重量) × 100%

VPPF 典型範圍：
  良好粉末（流動性佳、顆粒均一）：~2% RSD
  困難粉末（細粉、吸濕性強）：~5% RSD

判斷標準：
  產品規格（Specification）的充填重量允差
  必須 > 設備的充填 RSD × 3σ
  才能確保製程能力指數 Cpk ≥ 1.33
blocks.en:
Fill accuracy metric:

RSD (Relative Standard Deviation) =
  (standard deviation / mean fill weight) × 100%

Typical VPPF range:
  Good powder (good flowability, uniform particles): ~2% RSD
  Difficult powder (fine powder, strongly hygroscopic): ~5% RSD

Acceptance criterion:
  The fill weight tolerance in the product specification
  must be > the equipment fill RSD × 3σ
  to ensure a process capability index Cpk ≥ 1.33

blocks.zh: 此表格是 VPPF 與 AF 技術選型評估的核心參考。關鍵洞察：VPPF 的最大優勢是速度（400 pcs/min）與充填重量範圍寬廣；最大弱點是 CIP/SIP 僅覆蓋部分系統，以及複雜的無菌組裝需求。若產品具有困難的粉末特性（如高黏性、易結塊），應在可行性評估（feasibility study）階段就充分測試，避免在商業化生產後才發現設備不適合。
blocks.en: This table is the core reference for VPPF vs AF technology selection. Key insight: the greatest strengths of the VPPF are speed (400 pcs/min) and a wide fill weight range; its greatest weaknesses are that CIP/SIP covers only part of the system and that aseptic assembly is complex. If the product has difficult powder characteristics (such as high stickiness or a tendency to cake), these should be tested thoroughly at the feasibility study stage, to avoid discovering that the equipment is unsuitable only after commercial production has begun.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 技術評估報告中，這個優缺點表格應成為設備選型決策文件的核心章節。建議格式：針對每個風險項目，說明客戶產品是否受影響，以及計畫採取的緩解措施（如超級板設計緩解組裝複雜度、粉塵收集裝置緩解揚塵風險）。這樣的文件既是技術評估，也是合規文件，可以在 FDA 或 EMA 視察時支持你的技術選型決策。
blocks.en: In a CDMO technical assessment report, this table of benefits and risks should be a core chapter of the equipment selection decision document. The suggested format is, for each risk item, to state whether the client's product is affected and what mitigation is planned (for example, the super plate design to mitigate assembly complexity and a dust collection device to mitigate dusting risk). Such a document is both a technical assessment and a compliance document, and it can support your technology selection decision during an FDA or EMA inspection.

blocks.zh: 若客戶的產品充填重量規格為 200 mg ± 10 mg（允差 ±5%），VPPF 在最差情況下（5% RSD）能否滿足此規格？請用 Cpk 計算驗證你的答案。
blocks.en: If the client's product fill weight specification is 200 mg ± 10 mg (tolerance ±5%), can the VPPF meet this specification in the worst case (5% RSD)? Verify your answer with a Cpk calculation.

blocks.zh: 「低維護（Low maintenance）」被列為 VPPF 的優點，但前面章節又提到軸承、皮帶、氣動旋轉接頭的更換需求，如何理解這兩者的關係？
blocks.en: "Low maintenance" is listed as a benefit of the VPPF, yet earlier sections mention the need to replace bearings, belts and the pneumatic rotary joint. How do you reconcile the two?

blocks.zh: 若隔離器（isolator）的傳遞口（RTP）尺寸有限，為何這可能影響 VPPF 的無菌設置操作？有哪些工程解決方案？
blocks.en: If the transfer port (RTP) of the isolator has limited size, why might this affect the aseptic setup of the VPPF? What engineering solutions are there?

blocks.zh: 16.3 Aseptic Filling Technologies: Auger Powder Filling 16.3 無菌充填技術：螺旋推進粉末充填
blocks.en: 16.3 Aseptic Filling Technologies: Auger Powder Filling

blocks.zh: 螺旋充填機（Auger Filler，AF）：以螺旋桿（auger/screw）的機械旋轉帶動粉末，精確計量並充填進容器。與 VPPF 的氣壓充填不同，AF 是純機械式輸送，沒有氣流擾動，適合容易揚塵或高毒性的粉末產品。
blocks.en: Auger Filler (AF): uses the mechanical rotation of an auger (screw) to drive powder, metering it precisely and filling it into the container. Unlike the pneumatic filling of the VPPF, the AF is purely mechanical conveying with no air flow disturbance, making it suitable for powder products that dust easily or are highly toxic.

blocks.zh: 充填劑量決定因素：AF 的充填量由兩個參數決定：(1) 螺旋桿直徑（決定每轉一圈輸送的粉末體積）；(2) 旋轉圈數（決定總充填量）。這兩個參數構成了 AF 最核心的 CPP（關鍵製程參數）。
blocks.en: Determinants of fill dose: the AF fill amount is determined by two parameters: (1) the auger diameter (which determines the powder volume delivered per revolution) and (2) the number of revolutions (which determines the total fill amount). These two parameters are the core CPPs (Critical Process Parameters) of the AF.

blocks.zh: 排氣系統（venting system）：料斗中的排氣口設計至關重要——充填時粉末進入容器會排出容器內的空氣，若沒有適當的排氣設計，料斗內的背壓（back-pressure）會干擾粉末流動，導致充填重量不穩定。
blocks.en: Venting system: the vent design in the hopper is critical. When powder enters the container during filling, it displaces air from the container, and without a proper vent design the back-pressure in the hopper interferes with powder flow and makes the fill weight unstable.

blocks.zh: AF 就像廚師用義大利麵機把麵團推出成麵條——靠的是機械螺旋的推力，而不是吹氣。轉幾圈就出幾段麵條（充填幾克的粉末），非常精確、可控，而且不會把麵粉揚到空氣中。對比 VPPF 是「用氣流把粉末吹進容器」，AF 是「用螺旋把粉末壓進容器」，前者揚塵風險高，後者幾乎沒有揚塵。
blocks.en: The AF is like a cook pushing dough out of a pasta machine to make noodles: it relies on the thrust of a mechanical screw, not on blowing air. A set number of turns produces a set length of noodle (a set number of grams of powder), which is very precise and controllable and does not throw flour into the air. By contrast, the VPPF "blows powder into the container with air flow" while the AF "presses powder into the container with a screw"; the former has a high dusting risk and the latter almost none.

blocks.zh: AF 能夠 CIP/SIP 的根本原因：AF 的管道系統（料斗、螺旋管）全程密閉，流體（清洗液、蒸汽）可以在不拆解的情況下通過整個流路，完成清洗與滅菌。這與 VPPF 的劑量盤設計形成鮮明對比——VPPF 的劑量盤是圓形旋轉件，無法形成密封的 CIP/SIP 流路。這個根本性的機械設計差異，決定了兩種技術在 CIP/SIP 能力上的本質不同。
blocks.en: The fundamental reason the AF can be CIP/SIP: the AF piping system (hopper and auger tube) is fully enclosed, so fluids (cleaning solution and steam) can pass through the entire flow path to complete cleaning and sterilization without dismantling. This contrasts sharply with the VPPF dosing disc, which is a round rotating part and cannot form a sealed CIP/SIP flow path. This fundamental mechanical design difference determines the essential difference in CIP/SIP capability between the two technologies.

blocks.zh: 若 AF 充填頭（dosing auger）的直徑增大，充填量會如何變化？若要維持同樣的充填量，旋轉圈數應如何調整？
blocks.en: If the diameter of the AF dosing auger increases, how does the fill amount change? To maintain the same fill amount, how should the number of revolutions be adjusted?

blocks.zh: 為何 AF 特別適合「密閉充填」（containment）應用？從粉末輸送機制的角度解釋。
blocks.en: Why is the AF particularly suitable for containment applications? Explain from the standpoint of the powder conveying mechanism.

blocks.zh: 16.3.1 Auger Powder Filler Setup 16.3.1 螺旋推進粉末充填機安裝
blocks.en: 16.3.1 Auger Powder Filler Setup

blocks.zh: 影響 AF 充填精度的環境因素：粉末的充填精度不只是設備本身的問題，環境條件同樣關鍵：
blocks.en: Environmental factors affecting AF fill accuracy: fill accuracy is not only a matter of the equipment itself; environmental conditions are equally critical:

blocks.zh: 濕度（humidity）：粉末吸濕後流動性改變，充填量可能漂移
blocks.en: Humidity: powder flowability changes after moisture uptake, and the fill amount may drift

blocks.zh: 溫度（temperature）：影響粉末體積密度（bulk density）
blocks.en: Temperature: affects the bulk density of the powder

blocks.zh: 氣流（airflow）：HVAC 的送風方向可能干擾料斗中的粉末分佈
blocks.en: Airflow: the supply air direction of the HVAC may disturb the powder distribution in the hopper

blocks.zh: 粒徑分佈（particle-size distribution）：批次間粒徑變異會導致充填量不一致
blocks.en: Particle-size distribution: batch-to-batch variation in particle size leads to inconsistent fill amounts

blocks.zh: 攪拌（agitation）：料斗中的攪拌機構確保粉末不結塊、持續均勻流動到螺旋桿，是維持充填精度一致性的關鍵設計。
blocks.en: Agitation: the agitation mechanism in the hopper keeps the powder from caking and flowing evenly to the auger, and is a key design feature for maintaining consistent fill accuracy.

blocks.zh: IPC（In-Process Control，製程中管控）的強度選擇反映了品質風險管理（QRM）的思維：統計抽樣（statistical weight check）是最低要求，能偵測重大漂移；100% 重量檢測（in-line 100% weighing）則能偵測每一個容器的偏差，提供最完整的品質保證。文件明確建議：即使不是強制要求，100% 重量檢測也是「強烈推薦的升級（highly recommended upgrade）」。這個立場體現了決策層級——產品 CQA（充填重量）的保護優先於設備成本的節省。
blocks.en: The strength of IPC (In-Process Control) chosen reflects quality risk management (QRM) thinking: statistical weight checks are the minimum requirement and can detect major drift, while in-line 100% weighing detects the deviation of every container and provides the most complete quality assurance. The document explicitly recommends that, even where not mandatory, 100% weight checking is a "highly recommended upgrade". This position reflects the decision hierarchy: protecting the product CQA (fill weight) takes priority over saving equipment cost.

blocks.zh: 想像一家糕餅店用機器分裝餅乾：若每塊餅乾的重量都需要精確符合標示，最好的方法是每一塊都過磅（100% 重量檢測），而不是每 10 塊才量一次（統計抽樣）。對藥廠來說，充填重量直接影響患者拿到的劑量，差異更是生死攸關，因此 100% 重量檢測是最符合患者安全優先的設計選擇。
blocks.en: Imagine a bakery using a machine to pack biscuits: if the weight of every biscuit must match the label exactly, the best method is to weigh every single one (100% weight checking), rather than measuring only once every 10 (statistical sampling). For a pharmaceutical plant, the fill weight directly affects the dose the patient receives, and a difference can be a matter of life and death, so 100% weight checking is the design choice most consistent with putting patient safety first.

blocks.zh: 若 AF 充填過程中偵測到充填重量有下降趨勢（trending low），操作員應首先檢查哪些可能原因？（提示：環境、粉末、設備三個面向）
blocks.en: If a downward trend in fill weight (trending low) is detected during AF filling, which possible causes should the operator check first? (Hint: environment, powder and equipment.)

blocks.zh: 統計抽樣與 100% 重量檢測在法規合規（ICH Q10、GMP）上各自的依據是什麼？哪種方式更易於在 QMS 中辯護？
blocks.en: What are the regulatory bases (ICH Q10, GMP) for statistical sampling and for 100% weight checking respectively? Which approach is easier to defend in the QMS?

blocks.zh: 16.3.2 Auger Powder Filler Product Characteristic Compatibility 16.3.2 螺旋推進粉末充填機產品特性相容性
blocks.en: 16.3.2 Auger Powder Filler Product Characteristic Compatibility

blocks.zh: 本小節是一個明確的交叉引用，指向 Section 17.0 中的綜合比較表格。這提示我們：PDA Guide No. 1 的架構設計是先分別介紹各技術（Section 14-16），然後在 Section 17 進行系統性的產品特性 vs. 充填技術相容性比較。若你正在做技術選型評估，Section 17 的表格是核心參考工具——在完成本節學習後，應接著研讀 Section 17 來完整掌握粉末充填技術的全貌。
blocks.en: This subsection is an explicit cross-reference to the comprehensive comparison table in Section 17.0. It shows that the structure of PDA Guide No. 1 is to introduce each technology separately first (Sections 14-16) and then make a systematic comparison of product characteristics against filling technology compatibility in Section 17. If you are carrying out a technology selection assessment, the Section 17 table is the core reference tool, and after finishing this section you should go on to study Section 17 to understand the full picture of powder filling technologies.

blocks.zh: 在進入 Section 17 的比較表格之前，你能預測哪些粉末特性（CQA）對 AF 和 VPPF 的影響是相同的，哪些是不同的？
blocks.en: Before turning to the comparison table in Section 17, can you predict which powder characteristics (CQAs) affect the AF and the VPPF in the same way, and which affect them differently?

blocks.zh: 16.3.3 Auger Powder Filler Filling Container Compatibility 16.3.3 螺旋推進粉末充填機充填容器相容性
blocks.en: 16.3.3 Auger Powder Filler Filling Container Compatibility

blocks.zh: 捲軸進料器（Scroll Feeder）vs 振動進料器（Vibration Feeder）：這是 AF 的兩種粉末進料設計。捲軸進料器以旋轉捲軸推動粉末；振動進料器以微振動帶動粉末流動。兩種設計的容器相容性相同，選擇通常取決於粉末特性（流動性、顆粒大小）。
blocks.en: Scroll feeder vs vibration feeder: these are the two powder feed designs of the AF. The scroll feeder pushes powder with a rotating scroll, and the vibration feeder moves powder with micro-vibration. Container compatibility is the same for both designs, and the choice usually depends on the powder characteristics (flowability and particle size).

blocks.zh: 巢式組件（nested components）：注射器（syringe）或卡式瓶（cartridge）在充填前通常以「巢式」托架方式排列，多支容器固定在同一個托架上。AF 充填巢式組件有兩種方式：(1) 機械手臂移動 XY 工作台，讓固定的充填頭對應到每個容器位置；(2) 將容器從巢式托架取出（denest）、充填後再放回（renest）。
blocks.en: Nested components: syringes or cartridges are usually arranged in "nested" trays before filling, with multiple containers held in the same tray. There are two ways for the AF to fill nested components: (1) a robotic arm moves an XY stage so that a fixed fill head lines up with each container position; or (2) the containers are removed from the nest tray (denest), filled, and then placed back (renest).

blocks.zh: 頸部直徑限制（minimum neck diameter 5 mm）：AF 的充填頭（螺旋管道）需要進入容器開口，因此容器頸部尺寸是硬性限制。安瓿（ampoule）因頸部極細且需要火封，AF 技術不適用。
blocks.en: Neck diameter limit (minimum neck diameter 5 mm): the AF fill head (auger tube) must enter the container opening, so container neck size is a hard limit. Ampoules have a very narrow neck and require flame sealing, so AF technology is not applicable to them.

blocks.zh: 巢式充填對 IPC 重量檢測的影響：使用 XY 工作台時，充填頭在容器間移動，每次充填後不易立即進行單支淨重（net weight）檢測，因為容器仍在巢式托架上，重量感測器難以準確量測個別容器的淨重。這意味著某些巢式充填設計可能只能做到統計抽樣，而無法實現 100% 重量檢測——這是影響劑量 CQA 保證能力的重要考量，選型時必須與客戶的品質要求對照確認。
blocks.en: Effect of nested filling on IPC weight checking: when an XY stage is used, the fill head moves between containers, and it is difficult to check the net weight of each individual container immediately after each fill, because the containers are still in the nest tray and the weight sensor cannot accurately measure the net weight of an individual container. This means some nested filling designs may only achieve statistical sampling and not 100% weight checking. This is an important consideration for the ability to assure the dose CQA, and during selection it must be confirmed against the client's quality requirements.

blocks.zh: 巢式充填的 XY 機械手臂就像辦公室的印表機打孔機：印表機位置固定，是紙張（充填容器）移動到印表機下方定位，完成每一個動作。若容器太多（大巢式托架），機械手臂移動時間就成為限制效率的因素，這也是為什麼效率（16.3.5節）是設計時需要特別考量的面向。
blocks.en: The XY robotic arm in nested filling is like the punch in an office printer-and-punch setup: the position of the printer is fixed, and it is the paper (the containers to be filled) that moves under the printer to be positioned for each action. If there are too many containers (a large nest tray), the arm's travel time becomes the factor limiting efficiency, which is why efficiency (Section 16.3.5) needs special consideration at the design stage.

blocks.zh: 客戶要求使用 AF 充填 1 mL 預填充注射器（pre-filled syringe），頸部直徑 6 mm。請評估此應用的可行性，並列出你會進一步確認的技術參數。
blocks.en: A client asks to use an AF to fill a 1 mL pre-filled syringe with a neck diameter of 6 mm. Assess the feasibility of this application and list the technical parameters you would confirm further.

blocks.zh: 若選擇「取出（denest）-充填-放回（renest）」的方式處理巢式注射器，這個流程在無菌保證上帶來哪些額外考量？
blocks.en: If the "denest-fill-renest" approach is chosen for nested syringes, what additional sterility assurance considerations does this process bring?

blocks.zh: 16.3.4 Auger Powder Filler Sterility Assurance (Microbial and Total Particles) 16.3.4 螺旋推進粉末充填機無菌保證（微生物與微粒總量）
blocks.en: 16.3.4 Auger Powder Filler Sterility Assurance (Microbial and Total Particles)

blocks.zh: 1-2 mm 間隙（gap）的設計矛盾：這個微小間隙是 AF 無菌保證的核心挑戰。間隙存在的原因是：(1) 容器尺寸公差（tolerance）：不同批次的容器高度有細微差異，充填頭不能緊壓瓶口否則可能損壞容器；(2) 淨重檢測：重量感測器需要充填頭與容器之間沒有機械接觸，才能準確量測。然而這 1-2 mm 的開放空間，就是粉末可能逸散到充填環境的唯一路徑。
blocks.en: The design contradiction of the 1-2 mm gap: this small gap is the core sterility assurance challenge of the AF. The gap exists because of (1) container dimensional tolerance: container heights differ slightly between batches, and the fill head cannot press tightly on the container mouth or it may damage the container; and (2) net weight checking: the weight sensor needs no mechanical contact between the fill head and the container in order to measure accurately. However, this 1-2 mm of open space is the only path by which powder can escape into the filling environment.

blocks.zh: AF 不允許無菌安裝的原因：AF 的多軸螺旋桿與攪拌機構（multi-axial screws and mixer）結構複雜，無法在無菌區域以人工方式完成無菌組裝——零件太多、太複雜，無法像 VPPF 的 super plate 那樣整體滅菌後再掛載。因此 AF 的唯一可行路徑是 CIP/SIP。
blocks.en: Why the AF does not allow aseptic setup: the multi-axial screws and mixer of the AF have a complex structure and cannot be assembled aseptically by hand in the aseptic area. There are too many parts and they are too complex to be sterilized as a whole and then mounted, as with the VPPF super plate. The only feasible route for the AF is therefore CIP/SIP.

blocks.zh: 螺旋管道的清洗挑戰：螺旋桿的內部（粉末通道）與外部（與料斗接觸的面）都需要清洗，且螺旋槽的形狀複雜，容易積粉。CIP/SIP 的設計必須確保清洗液能完整覆蓋所有表面，包含螺旋槽的死角。
blocks.en: Cleaning challenges of the auger tube: both the inside of the auger (the powder channel) and the outside (the surface in contact with the hopper) must be cleaned, and the shape of the auger flights is complex and prone to powder build-up. The CIP/SIP design must ensure that the cleaning solution fully covers all surfaces, including the dead spots in the auger flights.

blocks.zh: 環境監測（EM）位置設計是粉末充填的特有挑戰：粉末充填機比液體充填機寬，操作人員難以在不引入污染風險的情況下伸手放置微生物監測板（microbiological plates）。EU GMP Annex 1 要求持續監測充填關鍵區域，因此 EM 探頭的位置必須在設備設計初期（mock-up 階段）就規劃好，並在廠房驗收測試（FAT/SAT）中驗證放置的可行性。這是設備採購合約中必須明確要求廠商配合的設計條件。
blocks.en: Designing the environmental monitoring (EM) locations is a challenge specific to powder filling: a powder filler is wider than a liquid filler, and it is hard for operators to reach in and place microbiological plates without introducing contamination risk. EU GMP Annex 1 requires continuous monitoring of the critical filling zone, so the EM probe positions must be planned at the early mock-up stage of the equipment design, and the feasibility of placement verified in the factory and site acceptance tests (FAT/SAT). This is a design condition that the equipment purchase contract must explicitly require the supplier to support.

blocks.zh: AF 的密閉系統就像封閉式輸送帶，粉末在管道內移動，直到最後「出口」（1-2 mm 間隙）才接觸到外部環境。這個設計讓整個充填過程的污染暴露面積最小化——只有那最後的 1-2 mm 是「開放」的。對比 VPPF 的劑量盤充填，粉末在盤上是開放暴露的。從無菌保證的角度，AF 的密閉設計在充填過程中本身就是一個更優的污染控制策略。
blocks.en: The AF closed system is like an enclosed conveyor belt: the powder moves inside the pipe and does not touch the outside environment until the final "exit" (the 1-2 mm gap). This design minimizes the contamination exposure area throughout the filling process, with only that last 1-2 mm "open". By contrast, in VPPF dosing disc filling the powder is openly exposed on the disc. From the standpoint of sterility assurance, the closed design of the AF is itself a better contamination control strategy during filling.

blocks.zh: 在廠房設計階段，與 AF 設備商討論 EM 整合時，關鍵問題是：(1) 設備是否預留了 EM 感測器的安裝位置？(2) 感測器高度是否需要比液體充填機高（以避免粉末揚塵干擾）？(3) 微生物監測板的放置是否可以在不觸碰充填區域的情況下完成？這些問題若在設備安裝後才發現，改造成本將非常高昂，應在 FAT（Factory Acceptance Test）前就確認。
blocks.en: During facility design, the key questions when discussing EM integration with the AF supplier are: (1) has the equipment reserved mounting positions for EM sensors? (2) does the sensor height need to be higher than on a liquid filler (to avoid interference from powder dusting)? (3) can microbiological plates be placed without touching the filling zone? If these questions are only discovered after the equipment is installed, the cost of modification will be very high, and they should be settled before the FAT (Factory Acceptance Test).

blocks.zh: AF 的 CIP/SIP 驗證應包含哪些關鍵測試項目？（提示：清潔效果（TOC/conductivity）、乾燥效果（水分檢測）、滅菌效果（溫度分佈研究））
blocks.en: What key tests should the AF CIP/SIP validation include? (Hint: cleaning effectiveness (TOC/conductivity), drying effectiveness (moisture testing) and sterilization effectiveness (temperature distribution study).)

blocks.zh: 為何粉末充填機的 EM 探頭可能需要安裝在比液體充填機更高的位置？這個調整對 EU GMP Annex 1 的合規性有何影響？
blocks.en: Why might the EM probes of a powder filler need to be mounted higher than on a liquid filler? What effect does this adjustment have on compliance with EU GMP Annex 1?

blocks.zh: 「充填頭插入容器開口（descending past the plane of the opening）」設計的優缺點是什麼？它對容器頸部尺寸的要求有何影響？
blocks.en: What are the advantages and disadvantages of the design where "the fill head descends past the plane of the opening" into the container? What effect does it have on the container neck size requirement?

blocks.zh: 16.3.5 Auger Powder Filling Efficiency and Impact on Risk 16.3.5 螺旋推進粉末充填效率與風險影響
blocks.en: 16.3.5 Auger Powder Filling Efficiency and Impact on Risk

blocks.zh: 多道充填（multiple lanes）：AF 同樣可以配備多個螺旋充填頭以提升產能。每增加一個充填道，CIP/SIP 系統也需要對應覆蓋，確保每個充填頭的清洗與滅菌效果都通過驗證。
blocks.en: Multiple lanes: the AF can likewise be equipped with several auger fill heads to raise output. Each added lane must also be covered by the CIP/SIP system, to ensure that the cleaning and sterilization effectiveness of every fill head is validated.

blocks.zh: 分割充填系統（split-fill system）：某些產品需要將兩種成分分批充填（如藥粉與賦形劑分開充填），在這種配置下，CIP/SIP 的管路設計需要覆蓋所有充填點，並確保清洗順序與流路符合 GMP 要求。
blocks.en: Split-fill system: some products require two components to be filled in separate steps (for example, drug powder and excipient filled separately). In this configuration, the CIP/SIP piping design must cover all fill points and ensure that the cleaning sequence and flow path meet GMP requirements.

blocks.zh: CIP/SIP 設計的「未來適應性（scalability）」是一個常被忽視但非常重要的規劃面向：若在設備採購時只考慮現有的充填道數量，未來業務擴展需要增加充填道時，原有的 CIP/SIP 系統可能無法覆蓋新增的充填點，需要昂貴的改造工程。建議在採購合約中明確要求設備商提供「X 條充填道的 CIP/SIP 擴充方案」，即使第一期只啟用較少的充填道。
blocks.en: The "scalability" of the CIP/SIP design is a planning aspect that is often overlooked but very important: if only the current number of fill lanes is considered when the equipment is purchased, then when future business growth requires more lanes, the existing CIP/SIP system may not cover the added fill points and expensive retrofit work will be needed. It is advisable to require explicitly in the purchase contract that the supplier provide a "CIP/SIP expansion plan for X lanes", even if only a few lanes are enabled in the first phase.

blocks.zh: 若 AF 計劃未來從 2 條充填道擴充到 4 條充填道，CIP/SIP 系統的哪些組件可能需要升級（提示：管路、閥門、流量控制）？
blocks.en: If an AF is planned to expand from 2 lanes to 4 lanes in the future, which components of the CIP/SIP system may need upgrading? (Hint: piping, valves and flow control.)

blocks.zh: 分割充填（split-fill）的 CIP/SIP 驗證，與標準單一充填的 CIP/SIP 驗證，在設計上有哪些額外複雜度？
blocks.en: What additional complexity does CIP/SIP validation for split-fill have in design, compared with CIP/SIP validation for standard single-fill?

blocks.zh: 16.3.6 Auger Powder Filling Costs: Initial and Ongoing 16.3.6 螺旋推進粉末充填成本：初始與持續
blocks.en: 16.3.6 Auger Powder Filling Costs: Initial and Ongoing

blocks.zh: CIP/SIP 系統的額外初始成本：AF 的 CIP/SIP 需要配套的蒸汽供應、純水（WFI）供應、熱電偶、蒸汽疏水閥、排水管道及相應的驗證工作。這些系統成本不包含在設備本體報價中，但可能與設備本身同等量級。在廠房預算規劃中，AF 的「全套」初始成本 = 設備 + CIP/SIP 基礎設施。
blocks.en: Additional initial cost of the CIP/SIP system: AF CIP/SIP needs supporting steam supply, purified water (WFI) supply, thermocouples, steam traps, drain piping and the corresponding validation work. These system costs are not included in the equipment quotation but may be of the same order of magnitude as the equipment itself. In facility budget planning, the "full" initial cost of the AF = equipment + CIP/SIP infrastructure.

blocks.zh: AF 格式件（format parts）：不同充填重量需要不同直徑的螺旋桿（auger），以及對應的料斗出口與充填頭尺寸。與 VPPF 的劑量盤一樣，多格式需求會增加初始的格式件採購成本。
blocks.en: AF format parts: different fill weights require augers of different diameters, with matching hopper outlets and fill head sizes. Like the VPPF dosing discs, a multi-format requirement increases the initial purchase cost of format parts.

blocks.zh: 低耗材成本：AF 因為 CIP/SIP 取代了一次性耗材（不需要 VPPF 那樣大量的 O 型環、活塞、過濾器），且機械結構相對簡單，持續耗材成本非常低。這使 AF 的 TCO 模型呈現「前重後輕」——初始投入高（設備 + CIP/SIP），但後續持續成本低。
blocks.en: Low consumable cost: because CIP/SIP replaces single-use consumables (the AF does not need the large numbers of O-rings, pistons and filters that the VPPF does) and the mechanical structure is relatively simple, ongoing consumable cost is very low. This gives the AF a "front-loaded" TCO model: high initial investment (equipment + CIP/SIP) but low ongoing cost afterwards.

blocks.zh: AF 就像買電動車：前期購買成本（設備 + CIP/SIP 基礎設施）比傳統燃油車（VPPF）高，但後期的「油錢」（耗材費用）幾乎為零。長期使用下來，電動車的 TCO 往往更划算。這個邏輯在高產量、長期運行的商業化生產廠房中尤為成立。
blocks.en: The AF is like buying an electric car: the up-front purchase cost (equipment + CIP/SIP infrastructure) is higher than for a conventional petrol car (the VPPF), but the later "fuel cost" (consumable cost) is almost zero. Over long-term use, the TCO of the electric car is often more favorable. This logic holds especially in commercial production sites with high volumes and long-term operation.

blocks.zh: 若你需要向管理層報告 VPPF vs AF 的設備選型建議，你會建立一個幾年的 TCO 模型？哪些輸入變數對最終選擇影響最大？
blocks.en: If you had to report a VPPF vs AF equipment selection recommendation to management, what time horizon (how many years) would you build the TCO model over? Which input variables have the greatest effect on the final choice?

blocks.zh: 「CIP/SIP 使 SU 零件不必要」這個說法是否完全正確？AF 中是否有任何情況仍需考慮 SU 組件？
blocks.en: Is the statement "CIP/SIP makes SU parts unnecessary" entirely correct? Are there any cases in the AF where SU components should still be considered?

blocks.zh: 16.3.7 Auger Powder Filler System Complexity: Setup, Handling, and Changeover 16.3.7 螺旋推進粉末充填機系統複雜度：安裝、操作與換線
blocks.en: 16.3.7 Auger Powder Filler System Complexity: Setup, Handling, and Changeover

blocks.zh: AF 低設置複雜度的原因：AF 的絕大多數組裝工作在 CIP/SIP 之前就已完成——系統在 Grade C（或更低）環境中組裝好，完整執行 CIP/SIP 滅菌，然後只需連接粉末供料系統即可啟動充填。對比 VPPF 需要在無菌環境中逐一安裝活塞、O 型環，AF 的設置流程顯著簡化，無菌干預風險大幅降低。
blocks.en: Why AF setup complexity is low: the great majority of AF assembly work is completed before CIP/SIP. The system is assembled in a Grade C (or lower) environment, put through the full CIP/SIP sterilization, and then only the powder feed system needs to be connected to start filling. By comparison, the VPPF needs pistons and O-rings installed one by one in the aseptic environment, so the AF setup process is significantly simpler and the aseptic intervention risk is greatly reduced.

blocks.zh: 自動螺旋旋轉調整：與 VPPF 的活塞長度自動調整類似，現代 AF 系統通過 100% 重量回饋，自動調整螺旋桿的旋轉圈數，維持充填重量在規格範圍內——這是 AF 的閉迴路 CPP 控制。
blocks.en: Automatic auger rotation adjustment: similar to the automatic piston length adjustment of the VPPF, modern AF systems use 100% weight feedback to adjust the number of auger revolutions automatically and keep the fill weight within the specification range. This is closed-loop CPP control for the AF.

blocks.zh: 粉末供料系統連接：AF 的唯一設置關鍵點是與散裝粉末供料系統（bin、keg 或袋子）的接口設計。這個連接必須符合粉末品質要求（避免污染）與無菌要求（若在無菌區連接），是設置程序（SOP）中需要嚴格規範的步驟。
blocks.en: Powder feed system connection: the only critical setup point for the AF is the interface design to the bulk powder feed system (bin, keg or bag). This connection must meet powder quality requirements (avoiding contamination) and sterility requirements (if connected in the aseptic area), and is a step that must be tightly specified in the setup procedure (SOP).

blocks.zh: AF 的設置就像即食咖啡機：整台機器（HEPA 過濾器、加熱系統、沖泡機構）在出廠前就完整安裝好，使用者只需要接上水源（連接粉末供料系統）就可以開始使用。對比 VPPF 設置就像每次使用前都要重新安裝咖啡機的每個零件——AF 的概念簡化了使用者需要在無菌環境中完成的工作。
blocks.en: AF setup is like an instant coffee machine: the whole machine (HEPA filter, heating system and brewing mechanism) is completely installed before it leaves the factory, and the user only has to connect the water supply (the powder feed system) to start using it. By comparison, VPPF setup is like reinstalling every part of the coffee machine before each use. The AF concept simplifies the work the user must complete in the aseptic environment.

blocks.zh: AF vs VPPF 設置複雜度的本質差異：VPPF 的複雜度在「設置階段（無菌干預多）」；AF 的複雜度在「CIP/SIP 系統設計與驗證階段（基礎設施要求高）」。兩者都有複雜度，只是複雜度的位置不同。VPPF 的複雜度是每次批次生產都重複的操作複雜度；AF 的複雜度是一次性的工程複雜度（設計 + 驗證）。從生產運營的角度，AF 的「一次性工程投入換取長期操作簡化」模式，更符合商業化生產的效率需求。
blocks.en: The essential difference in setup complexity between the AF and VPPF: the VPPF's complexity lies in the "setup stage (many aseptic interventions)", while the AF's complexity lies in the "CIP/SIP system design and validation stage (high infrastructure requirements)". Both have complexity, just in different places. The VPPF's complexity is operational complexity repeated for every production batch, whereas the AF's complexity is one-time engineering complexity (design + validation). From a production operations standpoint, the AF model of "one-time engineering investment in exchange for long-term operational simplification" better fits the efficiency needs of commercial production.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 評估高頻率、多規格的粉末充填業務時，AF 的低設置複雜度意味著：換產（changeover）時間短、操作員培訓成本低、批次間設置失誤風險低。這些因素對於 CDMO 的運營效率與客戶交期承諾都有正面影響，應在業務開發報告中量化呈現（例如：AF 換產時間 vs VPPF 換產時間的對比）。
blocks.en: When a CDMO evaluates high-frequency, multi-strength powder filling business, the low setup complexity of the AF means shorter changeover time, lower operator training cost and a lower risk of setup errors between batches. These factors all have a positive effect on the CDMO's operating efficiency and client delivery commitments, and should be quantified in the business development report (for example, AF changeover time vs VPPF changeover time).

blocks.zh: AF 完成 CIP/SIP 後，與粉末供料系統（如 IBC bin）的連接操作，在無菌保證上需要注意哪些事項？連接介面的設計應符合哪些 GMP 要求？
blocks.en: After the AF completes CIP/SIP, what sterility assurance points need attention in the connection to the powder feed system (such as an IBC bin)? Which GMP requirements should the design of the connection interface meet?

blocks.zh: 若 AF 需要在同一天充填兩個不同配方的批次（換產），完整的換產流程包含哪些步驟？每個步驟的關鍵控制點是什麼？
blocks.en: If an AF needs to fill two batches of different formulations on the same day (changeover), what steps does the full changeover process include? What are the key control points of each step?

blocks.zh: 「自動調整螺旋旋轉圈數」的功能屬於 CPP 的自動控制，這個功能是否需要在工藝驗證（process validation）中進行驗證？如何設計驗證研究？
blocks.en: The "automatic adjustment of auger revolutions" function is automatic control of a CPP. Does this function need to be validated in process validation? How would you design the validation study?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: VPPF 速度優勢明顯（最高 400 pcs/min），但多充填頭設計帶來更多無菌干預需求，設置複雜度高。Super plate 概念是降低無菌組裝風險的關鍵創新，但需要廠房提供 Grade A 運輸路徑。
blocks.en: The VPPF has a clear speed advantage (up to 400 pcs/min), but the multi-fill-head design brings more aseptic intervention needs and high setup complexity. The super plate concept is the key innovation for reducing aseptic assembly risk, but it requires the facility to provide a Grade A transport path.

blocks.zh: VPPF 的 CIP/SIP 只覆蓋進料料斗，劑量盤等精密件必須離線清洗。這是 VPPF 在多產品共用設備環境下清潔驗證負擔較重的根本原因。
blocks.en: VPPF CIP/SIP covers only the bulk-feed hopper, and precision parts such as the dosing disc must be cleaned off-line. This is the fundamental reason for the heavier cleaning validation burden of the VPPF in multi-product shared equipment environments.

blocks.zh: VPPF 對高毒性產品適用性有限：氣壓充填機制在處理細粉時可能產生揚塵，需要額外的工程控制（粉塵收集、充填針頭插入設計）；離線清洗也增加暴露風險。
blocks.en: The VPPF has limited suitability for highly toxic products: the pneumatic filling mechanism can generate dust when handling fine powders and needs additional engineering controls (dust collection, fill needle insertion design), and off-line cleaning also adds exposure risk.

blocks.zh: AF 完整 CIP/SIP 能力是其核心優勢：設置複雜度低（CIP/SIP 前完成組裝），無菌干預最小化；密閉系統設計使其成為高毒性產品充填的首選技術。
blocks.en: Full CIP/SIP capability is the core advantage of the AF: setup complexity is low (assembly is completed before CIP/SIP) and aseptic interventions are minimized, and the closed system design makes it the preferred technology for filling highly toxic products.

blocks.zh: AF 的 1-2 mm 充填間隙是無菌保證的固有挑戰，充填針頭插入設計可緩解此風險；環境監測位置規劃必須在設備設計初期（mock-up 階段）就確認。
blocks.en: The 1-2 mm fill gap of the AF is an inherent sterility assurance challenge, which a fill needle insertion design can mitigate; EM location planning must be confirmed at the early equipment design stage (mock-up stage).

blocks.zh: 決策層級貫穿全節：無菌保證（Sterility Assurance）永遠優先——無論是 VPPF 的 super plate 選擇、AF 的 CIP/SIP 投資，還是高毒性產品的技術選型，都必須先確保最高等級的無菌保證，再考量產品 CQA 與商業效率。
blocks.en: The decision hierarchy runs through the whole section: sterility assurance always comes first. Whether it is the super plate choice for the VPPF, the CIP/SIP investment for the AF, or technology selection for highly toxic products, the highest level of sterility assurance must be secured first, before considering product CQA and commercial efficiency.
